module Network.MCP.Client.Types

-- | Client state
data Client
Client :: ClientConfig -> MVar (Maybe ProcessHandle) -> MVar (Maybe Handle) -> MVar (Maybe Handle) -> Client
[clientConfig] :: Client -> ClientConfig
[clientProcess] :: Client -> MVar (Maybe ProcessHandle)
[clientStdin] :: Client -> MVar (Maybe Handle)
[clientStdout] :: Client -> MVar (Maybe Handle)

-- | Client configuration
data ClientConfig
ClientConfig :: Text -> Text -> Value -> ClientConfig
[clientName] :: ClientConfig -> Text
[clientVersion] :: ClientConfig -> Text
[clientCapabilities] :: ClientConfig -> Value
data McpClientError
ConnectionError :: Text -> McpClientError
ProtocolError :: Text -> McpClientError
ServerError :: Maybe Int -> Text -> Maybe Value -> McpClientError
[serverErrorCode] :: McpClientError -> Maybe Int
[serverErrorMessage] :: McpClientError -> Text
[serverErrorData] :: McpClientError -> Maybe Value
instance GHC.Internal.Exception.Type.Exception Network.MCP.Client.Types.McpClientError
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show Network.MCP.Client.Types.McpClientError

module Network.MCP.Client.Request
validateJsonRpcRequest :: Value -> Either McpClientError ()
sendClientRequest :: Client -> Value -> IO Value
parseResponse :: KeyMap Value -> IO Value

module Network.MCP.Client

-- | Create a new client
createClient :: ClientConfig -> IO Client

-- | Connect to the MCP server via StdIO
connectClient :: Client -> FilePath -> [String] -> IO Client

-- | Disconnect from the server
disconnectClient :: Client -> IO ()

-- | List available tools
listTools :: Client -> IO [Value]

-- | Call a tool with arguments
callTool :: Client -> Text -> Map Text Value -> IO Value

-- | List available resources
listResources :: Client -> IO [Value]

-- | Read a specific resource
readResource :: Client -> Text -> IO Value
listPrompts :: Client -> IO [Value]

-- | Get a specific prompt
getPrompt :: Client -> Text -> Map Text Value -> IO Value

module Network.MCP.Transport.Types

-- | Transport interface for all transport implementations
class Transport t

-- | Keep processing messages using the provided handler. Will only return
--   if the transport mechanism signals termination; e.g. EOF on a socket
--   or similar.
handleMessages :: Transport t => t -> (Message -> IO (Maybe Message)) -> IO ()

-- | Combined message type for the transport layer
data Message
RequestMessage :: Request -> Message
ResponseMessage :: Response -> Message
NotificationMessage :: Notification -> Message

-- | JSON-RPC Request
data Request
Request :: JSONRPC -> Value -> Text -> Maybe Value -> Request
[requestJsonrpc] :: Request -> JSONRPC
[requestId] :: Request -> Value
[requestMethod] :: Request -> Text
[requestParams] :: Request -> Maybe Value

-- | JSON-RPC Response
data Response
Response :: JSONRPC -> Value -> Maybe Value -> Maybe ErrorResponse -> Response
[responseJsonrpc] :: Response -> JSONRPC
[responseId] :: Response -> Value
[responseResult] :: Response -> Maybe Value
[responseError] :: Response -> Maybe ErrorResponse

-- | JSON-RPC Notification (no ID)
data Notification
Notification :: JSONRPC -> Text -> Maybe Value -> Notification
[notificationJsonrpc] :: Notification -> JSONRPC
[notificationMethod] :: Notification -> Text
[notificationParams] :: Notification -> Maybe Value

-- | JSON-RPC Error Response
data ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse :: Int -> Text -> Maybe Value -> ErrorResponse
[errorCode] :: ErrorResponse -> Int
[errorMessage] :: ErrorResponse -> Text
[errorData] :: ErrorResponse -> Maybe Value

data TransportError
TransportError :: String -> TransportError
newtype JSONRPC

[unJSONRPC] :: JSONRPC -> Text

ResourceContent :: Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> Maybe Text -> ResourceContent

-- | Optional MIME type

-- | Blob content (base64 encoded, if BlobContent)

[toolDescription] :: Tool -> Maybe Text

-- | JSON schema for tool parameters

-- | Optional annotations

data ToolContent
ToolContent :: ToolContentType -> Maybe Text -> ToolContent

-- | Type of content

-- | Text content (if TextContent) More fields would be here for image and
--   resource, simplified for brevity

-- | Tool content type
data ToolContentType
TextualContent :: ToolContentType
ImageContent :: ToolContentType
EmbeddedResource :: ToolContentType
data ToolAnnotations
ToolAnnotations :: Maybe Text -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Bool -> Maybe Bool -> ToolAnnotations

-- | Human-readable title for the tool
[title] :: ToolAnnotations -> Maybe Text

-- | If true, the tool does not modify its environment
[readOnlyHint] :: ToolAnnotations -> Maybe Bool

-- | If true, the tool may perform destructive updates
[destructiveHint] :: ToolAnnotations -> Maybe Bool

-- | If true, repeated calls with same args have no additional effect
[idempotentHint] :: ToolAnnotations -> Maybe Bool

-- | If true, tool interacts with external entities
[openWorldHint] :: ToolAnnotations -> Maybe Bool

module Network.MCP.Server.Types

-- | Server type with resources, tools, prompts and handlers
data Server
Server :: ServerInfo -> ServerCapabilities -> TVar [Resource] -> TVar [Tool] -> TVar [Prompt] -> Text -> TVar (Maybe ResourceReadHandler) -> TVar (Maybe ToolCallHandler) -> TVar (Maybe PromptHandler) -> TVar (Map Text (Value -> Server -> IO (Either SomeException Value))) -> Server

-- | Server information
[serverInfo] :: Server -> ServerInfo

-- | Server capabilities
[serverCapabilities] :: Server -> ServerCapabilities

-- | Available resources
[serverResources] :: Server -> TVar [Resource]

-- | Available tools
[serverTools] :: Server -> TVar [Tool]

-- | Available prompts
[serverPrompts] :: Server -> TVar [Prompt]

-- | Instructions
[serverInstructions] :: Server -> Text

-- | Resource read handler
[serverResourceReadHandler] :: Server -> TVar (Maybe ResourceReadHandler)

-- | Tool call handler
[serverToolCallHandler] :: Server -> TVar (Maybe ToolCallHandler)

-- | Prompt handler
[serverPromptHandler] :: Server -> TVar (Maybe PromptHandler)

-- | Request handlers by method
[serverMessageHandlers] :: Server -> TVar (Map Text (Value -> Server -> IO (Either SomeException Value)))

-- | Server handler for message processing
type ServerHandler = Server -> Value -> IO Value

-- | Resource read handler type
type ResourceReadHandler = ReadResourceRequest -> IO ReadResourceResult

-- | Tool call handler type
type ToolCallHandler = CallToolRequest -> IO CallToolResult

-- | Prompt handler type
type PromptHandler = GetPromptRequest -> IO GetPromptResult

module Network.MCP.Server

-- | Server type with resources, tools, prompts and handlers
data Server

-- | Server handler for message processing
type ServerHandler = Server -> Value -> IO Value

-- | Resource read handler type
type ResourceReadHandler = ReadResourceRequest -> IO ReadResourceResult

-- | Tool call handler type
type ToolCallHandler = CallToolRequest -> IO CallToolResult

-- | Prompt handler type
type PromptHandler = GetPromptRequest -> IO GetPromptResult
createServer :: ServerInfo -> ServerCapabilities -> Text -> IO Server

-- | Register available resources
registerResources :: Server -> [Resource] -> IO ()

-- | Register resource read handler
registerResourceReadHandler :: Server -> ResourceReadHandler -> IO ()

-- | Register available tools
registerTools :: Server -> [Tool] -> IO ()

-- | Register tool call handler
registerToolCallHandler :: Server -> ToolCallHandler -> IO ()

-- | Register available prompts
registerPrompts :: Server -> [Prompt] -> IO ()

-- | Register prompt handler
registerPromptHandler :: Server -> PromptHandler -> IO ()

-- | Run the server, handling messages until the transport mechanism shuts
--   down.
runServerWithTransport :: Transport t => Server -> t -> IO ()

-- | Run a transport server while the action is executed. If the action
--   throws an exception or terminates the server will be stopped.
withTransportServer :: Transport t => Server -> t -> (Async () -> IO a) -> IO a

-- | Handle a request
handleRequest :: Server -> Request -> IO (Either SomeException Response)
handleMessage :: Server -> Message -> IO (Maybe Message)

module Network.MCP.Server.StdIO

-- | Run an MCP server using STDIO transport, handling messages until the
--   transport is closed.
runServerWithSTDIO :: Server -> IO ()
withSTDIOServer :: Server -> (Async () -> IO a) -> IO a
